Error E-4012: pairing failed. Switch the device off, hold the power button for 8 seconds and pair again.
Error E-4021: the battery is too hot. Unplug the charger and let the device cool down for 10 minutes.
Error E-4102: the firmware update was interrupted. Keep the device plugged in and run the update again.
Error E-4210: the storage is full. Delete recordings in the app, then restart the device.
Error E-5003: the charger is not recognised. Use the original cable and a 5 volt adapter.
Error E-5030: the speaker has overheated. Turn the volume down and move it out of direct sunlight.
Error E-6001: the microphone is muted by the hardware switch. Slide the switch on the side to unmute.
Error E-6010: the USB-C port is damaged. Stop using the port and contact support for a repair.
Error E-4120: the left channel is silent. Check that the cable is fully inserted and update the firmware.
Error E-4201: the microphone input is clipping. Lower the gain in the app to below 70 percent.
Error E-5300: the power adapter is too weak. Use an adapter that gives at least 2 amps.
Error E-5033: the fan is blocked. Clean the vents with a soft brush and restart.
Error E-6100: the keyboard dongle is not found. Plug the dongle into a different USB port.
Error E-6101: the tablet screen is locked by a parental profile. Enter the profile PIN to continue.
Error E-7001: the Bluetooth range is exceeded. Move closer than 10 metres to the device.
Error E-7010: the recording could not be saved. Free at least 200 MB and try again.

Warranty policy: every Lumo product has a warranty against faults. The length depends on the product. Warranty claims are made in your account.
Refund policy: refunds go back to the original payment card within 5 business days after we receive the parcel.
Shipping policy: delivery is free on orders above AED 200. Orders below that pay AED 15.
Tracking: when your order ships you receive an email with a tracking link.
Returns policy: unopened items can be returned. Opened items only if they are faulty.
Battery care: do not leave a device at zero percent for weeks. Charge it to half before storing.
Billing: we accept all major cards. Invoices are in your account under Orders.
Account: use Forgot password on the login page to reset your password.
International orders: customs duties are paid by the customer and are not included in the price.
Compatibility: Lumo microphones and headsets plug into phones, tablets and laptops through USB-C.
Gift vouchers never expire and can be used on any product.
Support: contact us in the chat in your account, every day from 8 AM to 10 PM.
